item.title: TT-101 Reject impossible due dates
item.brief:
Implement ticket TT-101 from BACKLOG.md in the long-backlog repository.

Acceptance criteria:
- In tasktracker.dates, define InvalidDate as a ValueError subclass.
- parse_due(text, today) raises InvalidDate for impossible calendar dates, including 2026-02-30, 2025-02-29, 2026-04-31, 2026-13-01, and 2026-00-10; its message contains the original text.
- Any input that does not match a supported form also raises InvalidDate.
- Relative offsets accept +Nd, where N is nonnegative decimal digits: +Nd is N days after today, and +0d is today. Negative and unsigned forms such as -3d and 3d raise InvalidDate.
- today and tomorrow remain supported; matching is case-insensitive and ignores surrounding whitespace.
- Add tests for these behaviors. Keep existing tests passing.
- Use only the Python standard library.
- Run exactly: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
- Commit this ticket's changes in its own separate commit.

item.title: TT-104 Undo task store operations
item.brief:
Implement ticket TT-104 from BACKLOG.md in the long-backlog repository.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add TaskStore.undo() to revert the most recent not-yet-undone successful add, complete, or delete; repeated calls walk backward through the mixed operation history in LIFO order.
- Undoing add removes that task; undoing complete makes it open again; undoing delete restores the task exactly as it was under the same id.
- Never reuse ids, including after undoing an add.
- Define NothingToUndo in tasktracker.store and raise it from undo() when no operation remains to undo.
- Failed operations, such as completing an unknown id, must not be recorded.
- Add tests covering all operation kinds, mixed LIFO sequences, id restoration, id non-reuse, exhaustion, and failed operations. Keep existing tests passing.
- Use only the Python standard library.
- Run exactly: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
- Commit this ticket's changes in its own separate commit.

item.title: TT-103 Search query syntax
item.brief:
Implement ticket TT-103 from BACKLOG.md in the long-backlog repository.

Acceptance criteria:
- tasktracker.search.search(tasks, query) parses terms separated by whitespace, except whitespace inside double quotes; a quoted phrase is one term. All terms must match (AND).
- A bare word or phrase matches within titles case-insensitively.
- tag:NAME matches an exact task tag case-insensitively.
- status:open and status:done match task status.
- Any other field:value term, unknown status, or unterminated quote raises QueryError, defined in tasktracker.search.
- Empty or whitespace-only query matches every task; preserve input order.
- Add tests for supported terms, combinations, errors, and ordering. Keep existing tests passing.
- Use only the Python standard library.
- Run exactly: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
- Commit this ticket's changes in its own separate commit.

item.title: TT-102 RFC 4180 CSV export
item.brief:
Implement ticket TT-102 from BACKLOG.md in the long-backlog repository.

Acceptance criteria:
- tasktracker.export.to_csv(tasks) returns RFC 4180 CSV.
- Header is exactly id,title,tags,status,due; emit one row per task in input order.
- Join tags with semicolons. Render due dates as ISO YYYY-MM-DD or empty when absent.
- Quote a field only if it contains comma, double quote, CR, or LF; double embedded double quotes.
- Every line, including header and final row, ends with CRLF.
- Add tests including fields containing comma, quotes, CR and LF, and ordinary unquoted fields. Keep existing tests passing.
- Use only the Python standard library.
- Run exactly: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
- Commit this ticket's changes in its own separate commit.
